TextBlock.Text: Thimble: This is the strange seed I found, It appears to be deeply rooted into the ground.
Helenium: It's like nothing I've ever seen before - and this blinding light... If only we had a camera small enough to fit inside!
Thimble: Its branches appear to resemble that of Bramble Plants. Hypothesis; It is an evolved version of the plant we know!
Helenium: I suppose we will have to see what it does as it grows.
